name: mind
description: Mind — a CLI and web console that builds AGI agents you own: a soul of its own, memory recalled from your notes and documents, autonomy with a kill switch, A2A and Telegram, one git repo per agent, local-first.

scripts.build:macos: bun build bin/mind.ts --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/mind-darwin-arm64 && bun build bin/mind.ts --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/mind-darwin-x64
scripts.release:check: test -n "$MIND_RELEASE_MODEL" || { echo "release:check needs MIND_RELEASE_MODEL=<local ollama model> — the identity firewall (S6.4) is judged against a real model, and a release without that judgement does not ship (D-062)" >&2; exit 1; } && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run coverage && MIND_REAL_FIREWALL=1 MIND_REAL_MODEL="$MIND_RELEASE_MODEL" bun test test/soul/firewall.real.test.ts
